CustomField.description: Formula number: BlankValue(Form_Template_Page__r.Position__c,0) + the section's Position, producing a single sort key that orders sections first by page position then by section position. Used to sequence sections across the whole template. System-derived; not editable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only combined sort value that orders this section by its page's position and then its own position. It is calculated automatically; adjust the page Position and section Position to change ordering.
CustomField.label: SortPosition
